cases.mechanism_detail: A full-length L1 in HBB intron 2 reduces transcription of the allele (4.7-fold lower run-on rate) with promoter/enhancer hypermethylation and histone deacetylation-associated silencing; some primary transcripts are truncated at the L1, and minor aberrant transcripts (cryptic acceptors in IVS-II and in L1, intron+L1 retention) are NMD substrates.
cases.quote: The lower steady-state amount of mRNA produced by the β-globinL1 allele also resulted from a reduced rate of transcription and decreased production of full-length β-globin primary transcripts.
